page: Microsoft Azure F8ads_v7 is an x86_64 architecture server instance belonging to the Fadsv7 family. It features 8 dedicated physical cores and 8 vCPUs powered by an AMD EPYC 9V45 processor operating at a clock speed of 4.5 GHz. The CPU configuration includes 48 KB L1d cache, 1.0 MB L2 cache, and 32 MB L3 cache per core, alongside support for advanced instruction sets such as AVX-512, AVX_VNNI, and AVX512_BF16. The instance is equipped with 32.0 GB of system memory, yielding a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per core. Local storage is bundled, providing 945 GB of local disk capacity with Premium Storage capability. No GPU accelerators are included in this configuration.

In benchmark evaluations, the F8ads_v7 demonstrates top-tier single-core performance. Single-threaded stress-ng CPU tests, gzip compression, and bzip3 decompression all rank in the top 10% of tested systems. Multi-core performance, including multi-threaded bzip3 decompression and overall PassMark CPU scores, falls within the average tier. Memory bandwidth tests, such as large-block read and write operations, also align with average performance profiles. For lightweight machine learning tasks, the server achieves top-tier text generation speeds with small 135M parameter models, while prompt processing and medium 7B model inference remain in the average tier.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the F8ads_v7 offers a balanced resource density, combining high-frequency dedicated AMD EPYC cores with a substantial 945 GB local storage allocation. This hardware profile is well-suited for workloads requiring strong single-threaded CPU performance combined with local data caching. Appropriate workloads include relational databases, web serving, file compression pipelines, and general-purpose application hosting where dedicated CPU execution resources are required without the overhead of hyperthreading.
